mapper.select: select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, plant_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}
select c.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm from mst_cust c join srm_supplier s on s.cust_id = c.cust_id where c.use_yn = 'Y' order by c.cust_cd limit 2000

select l.po_line_id, p.po_no, l.line_no, p.po_date, p.status, trim_scale(l.recv_qty)::text as recv_qty, l.unit_cd from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id where p.cust_id = #{custId} and l.item_id = #{itemId} and p.source = 'SRM' and l.recv_qty > 0 order by p.po_date desc, p.po_id desc, l.line_no limit 200

select l.po_line_id, p.cust_id, l.item_id, l.unit_cd, case when l.unit_cd = i.unit_cd then 1 else ucp.factor end as po_factor, case when cast(#{unitCd} as varchar) = i.unit_cd then 1 else ucr.factor end as ret_factor, coalesce((select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd), (select (attrs ->> 'scale')::int from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = 'UNIT' and code = l.unit_cd)) as po_scale from srm_po_line l join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id left join mst_unit_conv ucp on ucp.item_id = l.item_id and ucp.from_unit = l.unit_cd and ucp.to_unit = i.unit_cd and ucp.use_yn = 'Y' left join mst_unit_conv ucr on ucr.item_id = l.item_id and ucr.from_unit = cast(#{unitCd} as varchar) and ucr.to_unit = i.unit_cd and ucr.use_yn = 'Y' where l.po_line_id = #{poLineId}
mapper.sql: r.return_id, r.return_no, r.cust_id, c.cust_cd, c.cust_nm, r.plant_cd, pl.plant_nm, r.ncr_id, r.ncr_no, r.ncr_line_no, r.lot_id, r.lot_no, r.po_line_id, p.po_no, l.line_no as po_line_no, r.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, r.unit_cd, trim_scale(r.qty)::text as qty, r.replace_yn, r.status, r.confirmed_at, r.confirmed_by, r.shipped_at, r.ship_ref, r.cancel_reason, r.remark, r.row_ver, r.created_at, r.created_by, r.updated_at, r.updated_by, l.unit_cd as po_unit_cd, trim_scale(greatest(l.qty - l.cancel_qty - l.recv_qty, 0))::text as po_open_qty

from srm_return r join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = r.cust_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = r.item_id left join sys_plant pl on pl.plant_cd = r.plant_cd left join srm_po_line l on l.po_line_id = r.po_line_id left join srm_po p on p.po_id = l.po_id
mapper.select: select x.* from () x order by x.created_at desc, x.return_id desc limit 2000

select x.* from () x order by
x.return_no x.cust_nm x.ncr_no x.item_cd x.status x.created_at
desc,
x.return_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select return_id, return_no, cust_id, plant_cd, ncr_id, ncr_no, ncr_line_no, lot_id, lot_no, item_id, unit_cd, status, row_ver from srm_return where return_id = #{returnId} for update
select r.ncr_id || ':' || r.ncr_line_no as k, r.return_no as no from srm_return r where r.cust_id = #{custId} and r.status <> 'CANCELLED' and r.ncr_id in #{n}

insert into srm_return (comp_cd, return_no, cust_id, plant_cd, ncr_id, ncr_no, ncr_line_no, lot_id, lot_no, po_line_id, item_id, unit_cd, qty, replace_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{no}, #{v.custId}, #{v.plantCd}, #{v.ncrId}, #{v.ncrNo}, #{v.lineNo}, #{v.lotId}, #{v.lotNo}, #{v.poLineId}, #{v.itemId}, #{v.unitCd}, #{v.qty}, #{v.replaceYn}, #{v.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning return_id

select k.claim_id as id, k.claim_no as no, k.status, n.ncr_no, (k.created_at at time zone #{zone})::date as created_on from srm_claim k join srm_claim_ncr n on n.claim_id = k.claim_id where n.ncr_id = #{ncrId} and k.cust_id = #{custId} and k.status <> 'CANCELLED' order by k.claim_id limit 200
